verdict.rationale: Lago documents a comprehensive public API with an OpenAPI 3.1 schema and states that usage charges can be updated via the API or the no-code UI, so API/UI parity is explicit for at least one area. No evidence claims parity across the whole product, and some guides describe UI-only flows such as clicking "Add a plan". Missing for 10: an explicit statement that everything doable in the UI is available via the API, parity coverage for areas beyond usage charges (plans, subscriptions, analytics, settings), and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Both non-engineers and engineers can update usage charges via API or Lago’s no-code UI.
Use Lago's OpenAPI 3.1 schema to generate clients, inspect typed operations, or expose billing actions to an AI agent.
Every endpoint in this reference has a generated command.
